selected_t18_target.exact_missing_invariant: For every profile row, row.thread.{designation,nominal_diameter,pitch,threads_per_inch,coarse_fine,standard_family} must equal the corresponding field on the thread-dataset record found by matching profile.thread_id to designation in the dataset selected by that row's thread system, with the same unit-routing buildThreadBlock() already applies.
selected_t18_target.why_t13_t17_do_not_cover_it: T13/T14 cover tap_drill.* derived from hp.cross_verified (different source object). T15 covers application_notes[].source on tap-types.json (different projection). T16 covers standards[] denormalization from knowledge.standardById (different source). T17 covers tap_types[] from the relationship graph (different source). None reads or compares the thread dataset files at all.
